metadata.title: Relative knot concordance
metadata.abstract: Motivated by the relative-slice problem in $4$-manifold topology, we define for a knot $R$ the notion of a relative knot concordance group $\mathcal{C}_R$ and analyze the structure of its algebraic analogue $\mathcal{AC}_R$ modulo torsion. Using Milnor signatures, we show that $\mathcal{AC}_R$ has infinite rank for every $R$. We also show that any prescribed finite set of natural numbers can be realized as orders of elements in a single relative concordance group.

analysis.workSummary: 为结 R 定义相对结协边群，借 Milnor signatures 证明其代数对应在模挠后对任意 R 都具有无限秩，并使任意给定有限自然数集合实现为同一个相对协边群中元素的阶。
analysis.breakthrough: 揭示相对版本中同时存在丰富的自由部分与可指定的有限阶结构。
